u1.bio: Golden retriever mom. Love morning walks in Łazienki. Always up for a coffee after.

u2.name: Tomasz K.
u2.bio: German Shepherd enthusiast. Max and I do 10 km every day, rain or shine.

u3.name: Monika N.
u3.bio: Frenchie and Chihuahua mom. Small dogs, big personalities. Praga Park is our spot.

u4.name: Adam Z.
u4.bio: Lab dad. Rocky is my best buddy. Looking for play dates around Ursynów.

u5.name: Kasia D.
u5.bio: Beagle mom. Zoe is obsessed with squirrels. We explore new parks every weekend.

u6.name: Michał W.
u6.bio: Two border collies, double the chaos. Training and agility enthusiast.

u7.name: Anna K.
u7.bio: Poodle mom. Lily loves the water. Zegrze Lake is our happy place.

u8.name: Piotr L.
u8.bio: Husky dad. Thor needs two hours of walking a day. Anyone game for adventures?

u9.name: Zuzia M.
u9.bio: Pom and Maltese mom. Cookie and Teddy are tiny but mighty. Dog-friendly cafés are life.

WALKS.title: Pole Mokotowskie Evening
WALKS.desc: Relaxed walk around the meadow. Great spot for dogs to run free.

WALKS.title: Morning Walk in Łazienki
WALKS.desc: Start at the main entrance by the Palace on the Water. Dogs love the squirrels here. Bring water for the dogs.

WALKS.title: Kabaty Forest Trek
WALKS.desc: Long forest trail through Kabaty. Off-leash areas available. Bring snacks.

WALKS.title: Wilanów Palace Walk
WALKS.desc: A walk around the Wilanów Palace grounds, with some of the best scenery in the city.

WALKS.title: Praga Park Meetup
WALKS.desc: Social walk for all breeds at Praga Park. Puppies welcome.

WALKS.title: City Centre Morning Run
WALKS.desc: Quick morning run through the city centre. Fast-paced, bring energetic dogs.

EVENTS.title: Lake Swim Day at Zegrze
EVENTS.desc: Swim day at Lake Zegrze. Dogs can swim, owners can relax on the beach. BBQ and refreshments available. 45 minutes by car from Warsaw.

EVENTS.title: Puppy Playdate Party
EVENTS.desc: Puppies under one year only. Safe, supervised playtime for young dogs to socialise. Bring a vaccination certificate.

EVENTS.title: WalkMe Community Meetup
EVENTS.photo: a crowd of dogs and owners in the park
EVENTS.desc: Our biggest community meetup. Join 50+ dogs and their owners at Łazienki. Food trucks, dog treats, and prizes for the cutest dog.

EVENTS.title: Dog Frisbee Competition
EVENTS.desc: Show off your dog’s frisbee skills. Open to all breeds. Prizes for distance, style, and accuracy. Register your dog at the event.

EVENTS.title: Night Walk — City Lights
EVENTS.desc: Twilight walk through the Old Town and riverside. Lights and reflective gear encouraged.

EVENTS.title: Dog Yoga (Doga)
EVENTS.desc: Yoga session in the park with your dogs. A certified instructor leads a 60-minute session. Mats provided.

w1.text: Hey everyone! So excited for this morning.
Zoe is already doing zoomies just thinking about it.
Meeting at the main entrance. Don’t forget water for the dogs!
Cookie and Teddy will be there!
Should we grab coffee after at PAWSOME?

w3.text: Starting in 30 min — the southern gate near the playground.
On my way! Mochi is so excited.
Bella says she’s ready (she’s actually still asleep, but whatever).
Lily just splashed through every puddle on the way.

m1.text: Hi! Saw you at Pole Mokotowskie the other day. Your dog is adorable.
Thank you! That’s Luna — she loves that park. Your golden is gorgeous too.
That’s Mochi! Want to do a park walk together sometime?
Absolutely. I’m free this weekend. How about Łazienki on Saturday morning?

m2.text: Hey! Your dog Luna is a golden? Zoe goes crazy for goldens.
Yes! Luna is very social too. Beagles are the best.
Come to the Wilanów walk this Friday! It’ll be fun.

m3.text: Luna looks exactly like my neighbour’s dog. Are goldens just the best or what?
